rationale: The description provides concrete monitoring, KPI-triggered network changes, rollout, and remediation automation. Anomaly notification and closed-loop automation are not described as learned or AI functionality.
evidence_spans: Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and notify of any anomalies.
Prepare network changes triggered by changes in KPIs and roll out these changes.
conflict_response: The labeler's uncertainty about whether anomaly detection or remediation is learned is not resolved by the text, but that missing implementation detail does not make the binary negative weak here. The description explicitly supplies conventional KPI monitoring, KPI-triggered changes, rollout, and automation; it contains no affirmative AI signal. Thus non_ai remains supported, with no subtype applicable.
